subsystems.name: Power and thermal control
subsystems.role: supplies the large amounts of electricity and heat rejection needed to run reactors and keep propellants cold.

subsystems.name: Excavation and feedstock handling
subsystems.role: digs up regolith or icy soil and delivers it to processing.

subsystems.name: Resource processing
subsystems.role: extracts oxygen and water from minerals or ice.

subsystems.name: Propellant synthesis
subsystems.role: combines carbon dioxide and hydrogen to make methane and water.

subsystems.name: Product storage and distribution
subsystems.role: stores and transfers cryogenic oxygen, methane and water.

subsystems.name: Construction and manufacturing
subsystems.role: turns regolith into building material or spare parts.

buildSteps.title: Prospect and survey the site
buildSteps.detail: Identify accessible water ice or suitable regolith, and characterise soil mechanics, ice content and hazards.

buildSteps.title: Emplace power source
buildSteps.detail: Land and deploy a fission surface reactor or large solar array, together with radiators to reject waste heat.

buildSteps.title: Set up excavation
buildSteps.detail: Deploy robotic excavators and haulers to mine regolith or icy soil and deliver it to the processing plant.

buildSteps.title: Prepare feedstock
buildSteps.detail: Crush, sieve and feed material into reactors at a controlled rate, avoiding jams in low gravity and vacuum.

buildSteps.title: Extract water and oxygen
buildSteps.detail: Heat regolith to release oxygen, and mine and melt ice then electrolyse water into hydrogen and oxygen.

buildSteps.title: Synthesise methane
buildSteps.detail: Use the Sabatier reaction with carbon dioxide from the atmosphere and hydrogen from electrolysis to produce methane and water.

buildSteps.title: Store and distribute products
buildSteps.detail: Liquefy and store oxygen and methane in cryogenic tanks, and transfer them to vehicles or habitats.

buildSteps.title: Construct infrastructure
buildSteps.detail: Sinter regolith into bricks or 3D-print landing pads and shelters to protect equipment and crews.

buildSteps.title: Commission and operate
buildSteps.detail: Run the plant autonomously with maintenance schedules and resupply of catalysts and spare parts.

prerequisites.why: Kilopower-type reactors have been tested on Earth but not flown; solar power is weak on Mars and unavailable during lunar night, so ISRU plants need reliable high-power sources.
Demonstrated in terrestrial mining and lab tests, but not yet on planetary surfaces with communication delays and abrasive dust.
Long-term storage and transfer of liquid oxygen and methane in space is still being developed to avoid boil-off losses.

prerequisites.tech: Catalysts and reactors for Sabatier and electrolysis
prerequisites.why: MOXIE on the Perseverance rover demonstrated carbon dioxide electrolysis on Mars, and Sabatier is well understood, but neither has run at full propellant-plant scale.
Only lab-scale reactors have operated; no full-scale oxygen extraction plant has run on the Moon or Mars.
Sintering and 3D printing with regolith simulants have been shown on Earth, but not in vacuum or low gravity.

pathway.milestone: Lab and subscale flight demonstrations, such as MOXIE on Mars producing oxygen from carbon dioxide
pathway.unlocks: proof that key chemistry works in space and data on dust, vacuum and thermal extremes.

pathway.milestone: Lunar polar ice prospecting and small-scale oxygen extraction
pathway.unlocks: water and oxygen for early lunar bases, and experience with icy regolith.

pathway.milestone: Pilot ISRU plant on Mars producing propellant for a return vehicle
pathway.unlocks: reduced launch mass and a sustainable architecture for human Mars missions.

pathway.milestone: Full-scale ISRU for sustained bases, construction and eventually export
pathway.unlocks: self-sufficient settlements and large-scale infrastructure built from local material.
